The formal deadlock condition is exactly the existence of a triangle in the undirected veto graph.
The incompatibility-domain definition reduces the required obstruction to an undirected graph triangle: each of the three candidate pairs must be a recorded mutual veto.
The partition condition on exactly three candidates is equivalent to non-bipartiteness, which occurs exactly when all three pairwise vetoes form a triangle.
